/Applications/Auto-Claude.app/Contents/R.description: ExecutionPhase enum defines workflow phases (PLANNING, CODING, QA_REVIEW, etc.) - added new phases: PUSHING_BRANCH, CREATING_PR, PUSH_FAILED, PR_CREATION_FAILED
BuildState enum defines UI status states (IDLE, PLANNING, BUILDING, etc.) - added new states: PUSHING_BRANCH, CREATING_PR, PUSH_FAILED, PR_CREATION_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW

ImplementationPlan dataclass now includes pr_created and branch_pushed fields for PR tracking. pr_created: { url: str, number: int, branch: str, created_at: str }, branch_pushed: { success: bool, timestamp: str }
IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_SCHEMA optional_fields now includes 'branch_pushed' and 'pr_created' for validation

~/Library/Application Support/auto-claud.description: Auto-claude MCP server QA tool location - this is where workflow state transitions happen. When QA status is "approved", it sets plan["status"] = "human_review". This is where new states (pushing_branch, creating_pr) need to be added.
MCP tool models and constants - defines all auto-claude MCP tools including TOOL_UPDATE_QA_STATUS. Contains agent configurations and MCP server mappings.

/Applications/Auto-Claude.app/Contents/R.description: update_qa_status tool now automatically pushes branch to remote when QA status is 'approved'. Uses _push_branch_to_remote helper with retry logic (--force-with-lease). Updates implementation_plan.json with branch_pushed status including success, timestamp, branch name, and message.

Added push_branch_to_remote() and get_remote_branch_exists() functions for git push operations. push_branch_to_remote handles first-time push with -u flag and existing remote branches with --force-with-lease for safety.
